title: Suspects arrested over the theft of crown jewels from the Louvre museum in Paris
summary: The Paris prosecutor said on Sunday that a number of suspects have been arrested over the theft of crown jewels from the Louvre museum in Paris last weekend.

title: RSF claims capture of the Sudanese army’s last major stronghold in Darfur
summary: The paramilitary Rapid Support Forces say it's captured the Sudanese army's headquarters in the city of el-Fasher.

title: Arrests made in Louvre jewellery heist by French police: Paris prosecutor
summary: Prosecutor confirms the arrests of suspects, including one detained while about to board a flight abroad.
